entities.summary: Muudea Sedik, known online as twomad, was a Canadian YouTuber and live streamer based in Los Angeles. Sedik created his second YouTube channel in 2016 and later, his main channel in 2017. He made gaming videos mainly about Overwatch before becoming known as an Internet troll. Several clips of himself became Internet memes, which allowed him to gain a following online. On February 13, 2024, Sedik was found dead in his residence due to a morphine overdose.
